lastCompletedStory.title: Make README and --help state the hardcoded permission mode truthfully

nextStoryContext: US-003 (CAM-458) rewrote every remaining README/--help surface that still framed bypassPermissions as config-driven (post-US-002 module deletion). README.md: the command-list note (was line 156-157, 'is read from ~/.config/cam/config.toml') and the Security section (was line 301-322, 'or the key is unset', named the now-deleted src/config/permission-mode.ts module) now both state the literal-at-every-spawn-site fact plus name all 4 spawn sites (run.ts, setup.ts, sidecar.ts, plan-runner.ts) and explicitly say the permission_mode config key 'is not read by any spawn path'; the CAM-457 worker_isolation/orchestrator-always-bypass disclosures were preserved verbatim. index.ts: the top-level footer and all 4 repeated per-command 'Behaviour' step-1 lines (cam plan/spec/issue/next, was 'Reads permission_mode from ~/.config/cam/config.toml (default: bypassPermissions)') were reworded to 'Permission mode is a hardcoded bypassPermissions literal at the spawn site' while preserving the exact substring '--permission-mode flag' (an acceptance-oracle anchor, do not drop it in a future edit). src/commands/claude.ts:59 Config-section help text ('Permission mode:  ~/.config/cam/config.toml') was reworded similarly, but note the nuance: `cam claude` itself still forwards args verbatim to the real `claude` binary, so a user CAN pass --permission-mode straight through as a forwarded arg (kept the 'cam claude --permission-mode <mode> <prompt>' example, reworded only the prose above it) -- this is a distinct fact from cam's own subcommands never accepting the flag, don't conflate the two in future wording. Gate note: the claude.ts reword grew the file 201->203 lines, past its file-size-budget.json ceiling; raised with a dated _ref entry (mirrors the US-002 precedent) and staged before re-running check:all. Deliberately NOT touched: README.md:258 (source-layout tree note mentioning ~/.config/cam/config.toml generically, not about permission mode) and docs/launch-readiness.md (dated audit report, out of this story's oracle scope, per the story notes). The 4 index.ts 'claude --permission-mode <mode> "/cam-plan"' pane-spawn command examples were left as-is (still literally accurate: the pane runs that argv, <mode> is just always bypassPermissions now) -- rewording those to spell out the literal was considered but is out of this story's scope (AC5/AC6 only require removing the config.toml claim and preserving the no-CLI-flag statement).
